meta.name: add-core-review
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "add a review type", "create a custom review", "add security review", "add performance review", or "create a new review category". Create a new custom review type with project-specific rules.

copy.tagline: 创建项目专属的审查类型
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常为项目添加新的审查规则
copy.tagline_en: Create custom review types for your project
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often add new review rules to projects

howto.what: Claude 会新建一种自定义审查类型：先问清审查重点、范围、规则和额外工具，再生成对应的 SKILL.md；若已有自我审查扩展，还询问是否接入新类型。
howto.when: 当你说“添加审查类型”“新建自定义审查”，或提到“加安全审查”这类具体审查时触发。

say.text: 新增一个 security 审查类型
say.note: 会引导你填审查重点、范围与规则。

say.text: 创建一个 plugin 专用审查
say.note: 生成规则会写入项目本地 skills 目录。

say.text: 把新审查接入自我审查扩展
say.note: 若存在扩展会提示选择代理与范围。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude creates a new custom review type: it asks for focus area, scope, rules, and extra tools, then writes the corresponding SKILL.md. If a self-review extension exists in the project, it also asks whether to wire the new type in.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says 'add a review type', 'create a custom review', or names a specific type such as 'add security review'.

say_en.note: Guides you through focus, scope, and rules.
Writes rules to the project's local skills directory.

say_en.text: Wire the new review into self-review.
say_en.note: If the extension exists, asks for agent and scope.
